title: coleus argenteus
intro: Coleus argenteus, commonly known as Silver Coleus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its stunning silver-gray leaves, which are highly valued for their unique coloration and versatility in ornamental arrangements. The leaves of the Coleus argenteus are rich in antioxidants and have been found to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Coleus argenteus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its ability to reduce stress and promote relaxation.
